name: Suloctidil

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1985 — for liver harm

summary: Suloctidil was removed from the market worldwide starting in 1985 because it caused damage to the liver [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated risk scores for the drug [M]. This computer program rated the drug's risk to both the heart and the liver as low [M].
